notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT: LOVE AND FEAR
notes.notes:
The new visual novel “Love and Fear” is completely ready and will be released on December 26, 2024!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3090800/Love_and_Fear/]Add to your wishlist[/url] so you don't miss the release.

What awaits you:

- Hikari's Backstory
- First love
- New heroes
- 6 (six) unique endings
- Mysterious murders
- A dangerous summer adventure
- Detective story

Subscribe [url=https://t.me/mangox2]to our social networks[/url] to be the first to know about all the news.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893273/f10d192c497f624606d3ee261972ce1cd116f41c.png[/img]
Find out Hikari's terrible past in the new novel "Love and Fear".
This short story is the background to the short story "Love and Crime".
You will learn everything about the dangerous events that happened to Hikari in the past... About why she became a fighter for justice and about her first love...

Don't miss the release date!
